content.text:
SYS-603 is fixed and verified. Summary:

- **`ResponsesForm.tsx`**: added `allowDeselect={false}` to the per-player Response `Select`, so clicking the already-selected option no longer clears it to `null`.
- **`ResponsesForm.vitest.spec.tsx`**: added a regression test confirming that reselecting an already-selected response ("Yes") leaves it unchanged and doesn't dirty the row.
- **`e2e/responses.spec.ts`**: removed the workaround that skipped reselecting an already-correct value (it existed specifically to dodge this bug, per the ticket's "Found while" note) — the flow now genuinely exercises reselection.

`typecheck`, `lint`, `format:check`, and `knip` all pass clean, and the component's Vitest suite (11 tests) passes. I didn't run the Playwright e2e suite itself (needs the dev server/DB), so that's worth a real run before merging. Nothing has been committed, per your standing preference — changes are staged in the working tree for review.
